title: Lund, Skåne — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lund, Skåne: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lund is a city in Skåne with a population of 94,000. A historic university city with a Romanesque cathedral, known for its research institutions and student life. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
